changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnosticordertestsreport AS SELECT dotr.id, dotr.order_test_id, dotr.report, dotr.severity, dotr.approved_by, dotr.approved_date, dotr.rejected_by, dotr.rejected_date, dotr.rejected_reason, dotr.review_by, dotr.review_date, dotr.second_approved_by, dotr.second_approved_date, dotr.processing_status, dotr.image_status, dotr.created_date, dotr.created_by, dotr.last_modified_by, dotr.last_modified_date, dotr.accession_number, dotr.radiologist_information, dotr.critical_findings, dotr.radiologist_comments FROM public.diagnostic_order_tests_report dotr;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnosticordertestsreport TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnosticordertestsreport FROM report_user;
